name: Bergmite
description: They chill the air around them to −150 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into ice that they use as armor.

moves.name: Harden
moves.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.description: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also raises the user’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also freeze opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.description: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.
